ns2:section.sectionText: ** Note: Prerequisites will be enforced. Course will open to sophomores in Advertising and Agricultural Communications by 8:30 am on November 9th. Understanding the strategies and application of digital technology in the implementation of advertising in today's marketplace. Students must have completed ADV 300 before enrolling in this course. Meets with ADV 590-F (CRN 45526). NOTE: If students have completed ADV 400-F (CRN45522) in any spring term or ADV 400-F (CRN 56068) in any fall term, you will not be able to take this course.
